rules.name: Hugging Face model
rules.what: Model weights and files downloaded from the Hugging Face Hub by transformers, diffusers and other libraries.
rules.comeback: Downloaded again the next time code loads the model, as long as it is still on the Hub.

rules.name: Hugging Face datasets
rules.what: Datasets downloaded and processed by the datasets library.
rules.comeback: Downloaded and processed again the next time code loads the dataset.

rules.name: Ollama models
rules.what: Models you have pulled with Ollama.
rules.comeback: Pull any model again with ollama pull. To remove just one, use ollama rm.

rules.name: LM Studio model
rules.what: Models in LM Studio's library. Some may have been imported from your own files rather than downloaded, so Leftover can't promise they come back.
rules.comeback: Models downloaded inside LM Studio can be downloaded again from its Discover tab.

rules.name: PyTorch Hub cache
rules.what: Models and weights downloaded through torch.hub and torchvision.
rules.comeback: Downloaded again the next time code loads them.

rules.name: Whisper models
rules.what: Speech recognition models downloaded by OpenAI's Whisper package.
rules.comeback: Downloaded again the first time you load a model.
